description: The dataset describes Excel calculations for a virtual district-heating network with one producer and five consumers. It compares operating schedules using outdoor temperature, flow and heat-loss calculations. The provider is Stanislav Chicherin. Coverage: The prototype is based on Canberra, Australia, with 5,561 metres of pipe and 2017 Canberra Airport weather. It is a hypothetical district, not evidence of an operating heat network. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. The public deposit provides a free access route; downstream software and third-party data may have separate conditions. Limitations: Results depend on idealised topology and nine selected schedules. Weather observations do not validate the proposed network or its operating performance. For simulation it offers a small thermal and pumping scenario case for method comparison. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
